messages:
olivia: morning - quick alert: staging eval runner wrote full customer prompts into s3 artifacts, dashboard alert triggered.
ci-bot: [CI] eval/runner job 842 failed - logs: https://ci.internal/runs/842
nate: ugh. is this tied to yesterday's KV-cache write change? could be dump_to_disk flag.
meera: yep, runner v2 still persists raw_prompts when debug_enabled=true. CI uses debug for faster replays.
sasha: that's a PII risk. any archived artifacts we need to purge immediately? I can start rotation of exposed keys.
olivia: creating ticket INF-1297 to track purge/rotation/patch. assigned meera to patch, sasha to security notifications.
meera: working on hotfix - switch from storing raw strings to storing prompt_hash + redacted snippet. patch snippet:
```
REDACT_PATTERNS = [r"[\\w.+-]+@[\\w.-]+\\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}", r"\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\b", r"\\b\\d{4}-\\d{4}-\\d{4}-\\d{4}\\b"]
def redact(s):
  for p in REDACT_PATTERNS:
    s = re.sub(p, "[REDACTED]", s)
  return s
```
jen: noted - archived artifacts are on s3://inference-evals/archive/. I can run expedited lifecycle and overwrite with redacted copies if you give the list.
sasha: also adding bucket policy to require iam:EvalRead role and block public list. patching IaC now.
olivia: critical action items: (1) purge/archive rewrite (jen), (2) disable debug flags in CI templates (meera + PR), (3) rotate any creds that appear in artifacts (security), (4) add auditing to dashboards for redaction failures (nate).
nate: I'll add an eval-health panel showing artifacts >1KB with unredacted regex hits and send pager if >0. Also adding CI hook to scan artifacts before upload.
ci-bot: [DEPLOY] hotfix branch release/runner-v2 merged by meera - build queued.
meera: deploying hotfix to staging now (ETA ~15m), will run a dry scan after deploy.
sasha: prepare customer notice template in case we need to escalate. prioritize customers with production traffic to this model.
olivia: agreed. keep updates here. after purge + hotfix, we'll follow up with a short postmortem and update the eval-runner docs about safe defaults.
meera: PR #1689 opened to remove debug_enabled from CI templates and include pre-upload redaction step.
nate: started adding regex scanner to the runner upload pipeline - will fail uploads with a non-zero exit on matches.
jen: purge started - listing 3k objects, staging rewrite underway. ETA ~40m.
sasha: rotating keys that showed in artifacts. security log events created and customers will be contacted if necessary.
olivia: thanks all. will attach INF-1297 postmortem draft here when ready. :lock:
